title: Unit 6 Consolidation: Aesthetics, Vision & Creative Obsession

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can form and deploy adverbial participles of manner (-va/-ve), stative resultatives (van + -va/-ve), and literary causal participles (-ván/-vén)
I can distinguish completed resulting states (meg van világítva) from dynamic visual processes (tükröződik, kirajzolódik)
I can actively use Unit 6's B2 vocabulary of visual art, aesthetics, and creative vision
